author.title: Instructor
author.subtitle: Not a slide-deck theorist — someone who ships.
author.name: Sergey Sidorov
author.role: Founder · project lead and product manager
author.bio: A professional in project management and IT product development. Much of his career was spent on flagship projects at Kaspersky Lab. He removes uncertainty, drives initiatives to completion, and designs systems that survive production. .NET, architecture, systems analysis, and AI — in one skill set.

1.question: Who is this school for?
1.answer: Project and product managers, systems analysts, and neighbouring IT roles who want practical skills — not certificates for their own sake.

2.question: Do I need to already know how to code?
2.answer: It depends on the course. Neither starting course has a hard coding prerequisite — check the description before enrolling.

3.question: How are courses delivered?
3.answer: Self-paced on the platform: chapters and lessons with text, images, video, and audio, with progress tracked as you go.

4.question: Can I suggest a course topic?
4.answer: Yes. Email hello{'@'}s-sidorov.ru — we keep every request, and courses can be shaped by what people actually ask for.

5.question: Who runs this school?
5.answer: One person so far — Sergey Sidorov. See the instructor section and s-sidorov.ru.
